android.permission.INTERNET.impact: Allows network connections; data exposure depends on app behavior and destination.
android.permission.INTERNET.recommended_action: Confirm network access is required and review the app's documented data handling.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.impact: Can provide approximate device location, which may reveal places the user visits.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.recommended_action: Prefer location access only while in use and only at the precision needed.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.impact: Can provide precise device location and expose sensitive movement patterns.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.recommended_action: Verify precise location is essential; prefer approximate or foreground-only access when feasible.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.impact: Can allow location access while the app is not actively in use.
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.recommended_action: Require a clear background feature justification and prefer foreground-only location.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.impact: Can read personal contact details stored on the device.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.recommended_action: Use a user-selected contact picker instead of broad address-book access when possible.

android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.impact: Can modify or add entries in the user's contacts.
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.recommended_action: Confirm contact editing is a documented core feature and minimize the fields changed.

android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.impact: Can discover account identifiers configured on the device.
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.recommended_action: Verify account discovery is necessary and avoid collecting unrelated account identifiers.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.impact: Can access the microphone when granted; the manifest declaration alone does not show when recording occurs.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.recommended_action: Request microphone access only for a user-visible feature and clearly indicate when recording is active.

android.permission.CAMERA.impact: Can access the camera when granted; the declaration does not establish that images are captured.
android.permission.CAMERA.recommended_action: Request camera access only when the user invokes a camera feature.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.impact: Can expose files in shared external storage, subject to Android version and access controls.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.recommended_action: Prefer Android's Storage Access Framework or a system photo picker for user-selected files.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.impact: Can allow writing shared external storage on Android versions where the permission applies.
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.recommended_action: Use scoped storage and write only files the user explicitly chooses.

android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.impact: Can provide broad access to shared storage beyond ordinary media selection.
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.recommended_action: Remove broad storage access unless a qualifying core use case requires it; prefer scoped storage.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.impact: Can access audio media stored on shared device storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.recommended_action: Use a user-selected media picker where broad library access is unnecessary.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.impact: Can access image media stored on shared device storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.recommended_action: Prefer a system photo picker or request only the selected images.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.impact: Can access video media stored on shared device storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.recommended_action: Prefer a user-selected media picker and limit access to files needed for the task.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USE.impact: Relates to access to images and video selected by the user.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USE.recommended_action: Keep visual-media access scoped to items selected by the user.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.impact: Allows the app to declare foreground-service operation, which can support ongoing visible work.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.recommended_action: Confirm any foreground service is user-visible, task-limited, and stopped when no longer needed.

android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.impact: Allows receiving a device boot event to schedule app work after startup.
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.recommended_action: Verify startup behavior is essential and defer work until the user needs it.

android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.impact: Can keep the device from sleeping while the app holds a wake lock.
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.recommended_action: Use bounded wake locks only while an active user-visible task requires them.

android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.impact: Can schedule time-sensitive alarms subject to Android's platform restrictions.
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.recommended_action: Use inexact scheduling unless exact timing is a documented core requirement.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.impact: Can send SMS messages, potentially incurring charges or contacting others.
android.permission.SEND_SMS.recommended_action: Prefer the system messaging intent so users review and send messages themselves.

android.permission.READ_SMS.impact: Can read SMS content, which may include private conversations or authentication codes.
android.permission.READ_SMS.recommended_action: Avoid broad SMS access; use user-mediated Android APIs for the specific task.

combinations.explanation: Location and contact access together can expose linked personal and movement data; the combination warrants context review.
combinations.recommended_action: Confirm both capabilities are necessary for a documented feature and minimize access scope.

combinations.explanation: Microphone and background-execution declarations together can enable audio-related work outside the immediate foreground; their co-occurrence alone does not show recording.
combinations.recommended_action: Verify microphone use is user-initiated and visible, and confirm background execution is essential and bounded.

combinations.explanation: File or media access together with network access can support data transfer; declarations alone do not establish that files are uploaded.
combinations.recommended_action: Review file selection, data-flow documentation, and network destinations; prefer user-selected files and disclose transfers.
